messages:
sasha: Heads-up: getting multiple customer reports of unexpected 429s starting ~2026-03-02T09:00:20Z. Most reports are from Dedicated accounts doing sustained throughput. Root thread here so we can coordinate.

devon: I can confirm spike in 429s at 09:00:22Z. Dashboard shows limiter error surge in eu-central and us-west-2. Sample request: req_1c9f3d. Error payload: {\"error\":\"quota_exceeded\",\"message\":\"Rate limit exceeded\"}. Will paste logs.

maya: I pushed limiter-config v1.12 at 08:55 UTC that introduced the new shared-burst policy (feature flag enabled: limiter.shared-burst=true). Intended target: hosted/shared customers only. I double-checked the flag state before deploy but might have missed a default scope fallback.

ops-bot: Incident created INC-2026-1521 by sasha (sev=P1). Notifying infra-oncall and support oncall.

sasha: Repro (quick):

1) curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/completions -H "Authorization: Bearer <ded-key>" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"open-rlhf-13b","prompt":"ping","max_tokens":10}' | jq .

Expected 200; observed 429 and body -> {\"error\":\"quota_exceeded\",\"detail\":\"token bucket empty\"}

log snippet:

```
2026-03-02T09:00:22Z limiter[pid=614]: apply_policy=shared-burst key=acct:ded-78 bucket=0/50 rate=5r/s -> REJECT 429 req=req_1c9f3d
2026-03-02T09:00:22Z proxy[pid=210]: upstream 10.7.1.11 returned 429 -> client 35.184.90.2
```

oliver: Quick mitigation: I disabled limiter.shared-burst flag at 09:03:11Z while we triage. Command used:

```
ffctl set limiter.shared-burst false --env prod
```

deploy-bot: feature flag change propagated to controllers at 09:04:02Z.

maya: Confirmed toggled. After toggle, 429s dropped back to baseline by ~09:05:30Z. I think the new policy's key derivation collapsed per-tenant buckets into a single acct-scoped bucket for Dedicated paths. Looking into config template.

devon: Root cause draft: key derivation function for the new policy used header.X-tenant-id only when present; otherwise it fell back to acct_id. During rollout, our Dedicated requests had empty X-tenant-id so they all mapped to the same acct bucket, causing noisy-neighbor exhaustion.

sasha: Customer impact: 4 Dedicated accounts reported degraded throughput (acct ids: ded-78, ded-83, ded-91, ded-114). CS notified and joining. Jordan, can you coordinate credits and comms?

jordan: On it. Will prepare a support note and initiate billing credits once we have the exact request sets. CS asked for a short customer-facing summary and ETA for fix.

oliver: I've started a DB query to capture all rejected requests for the affected accounts during the window.

```
SELECT request_id, acct_id, ts, status
FROM request_logs
WHERE acct_id IN ('ded-78','ded-83','ded-91','ded-114')
AND ts BETWEEN '2026-03-02T08:50:00Z' AND '2026-03-02T09:10:00Z'
AND status = 429;
```

maya: Patch ready: fix/key-derivation-defaults ensures fallback uses tenant_id derived from api_key metadata for Dedicated, and the policy template now requires explicit scope field. PR #438.

devon: Tests: we need an e2e that simulates empty X-tenant-id and verifies token buckets are per-tenant. Also add an alert: if 429 ratio for Dedicated > 0.5% for 3m trigger pager.

oliver: I've rolled PR #438 to canary at 09:18Z and will promote to prod after smoke tests.

deploy-bot: deploy limiter-service sha=9b7f1a to canary started at 09:19:02Z; health checks passing.

deploy-bot: promote to prod at 09:25:40Z; deploy completed 09:28:13Z; all pods healthy.

sasha: After deploy, metrics show no further large 429 bursts. ops-bot marked mitigated at 09:33:01Z.

jordan: CS update: initial customer notifications sent at 09:15Z (apology + short reason + rollback note). Finance pre-approved credits; awaiting exact totals.

maya: Follow-ups I will own:
- merge PR #438 and add gating so limiter feature flags must include explicit scope non-empty.
- add linter to rule templates to forbid unspecified scope.
- add unit + integration tests for key derivation path.

devon: Ops follow-ups:
- add a canary traffic test for limiter feature flags (5m at 1% traffic) before global rollout.
- create an alert for Dedicated 429 ratio and automated rollback that flips the feature flag if hit.

oliver: Support/Infra: automate extraction of affected requests and a dry-run credits script. Also add a quick rollback runbook step to ffctl usage docs.

sasha: Postmortem owners assigned; I'll draft the writeup with timeline. Also recommend a policy: no limiter rule should default to global keying without explicit tenant scoping. Thanks everyone for rapid response. :clap:

support-bot: Noted actions: create incident follow-up doc, link PRs (#438), and schedule a postmortem review meeting for 2026-03-04 16:00 UTC.

ops-bot: INC-2026-1521 status: mitigated (09:33:01Z).
